title: Jonshu's wells
description: This data pack adds new well variants to your Minecraft worlds, including Oak, Birch, & Spruce, which all have 4 different variants. This will provide you with starter loot to help you go on adventures throughout the Minecraft world.
body:
This data pack adds new well variants to your Minecraft worlds, including Oak, Birch, & Spruce, which all have 4 different variants. 

The well's purpose is to add depth to your world & help you in the early game by providing food & very basic tools. This is to help make the experience of the game smoother & works well in big modpacks!
There are plans for more biome wells & more variants of each well, adding depth to your world.
